facts.business: NIS Management Limited provides security guarding, facility management, and allied services including technology-enabled solutions across government, PSU, corporate, hospitality, manufacturing, healthcare, airports, education, and retail sectors in 14 states.
key_risks: growth in the number and size of customer contracts
retention and renewal of existing contracts
deployment of security personnel and facility management manpower
prevailing minimum wages and other statutory employee-related costs
competitive pricing in tenders and contracts
ability to provide value-added and integrated services
effective management of working capital and operating expenses
